Proposition
[Dependence of $\Phi _p$ on $p$] 1. ch7:7.8–7.10\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0158 For fixed $u$, $\Phi _p(u)$ is nondecreasing in $p$ and logarithmically convex as a function of $p^{-1}$. For $p\geq 1$, $\Phi _p(u)=|\Omega |^{-1/p}\| u\| _p$.
Proof

\sketch The monotonicity is (7.8) after normalization by $|\Omega |$; logarithmic convexity is (7.9).

□

For $p<\infty $, $L^p(\Omega )$ is separable. Its dual is $L^{p'}(\Omega )$, where $p^{-1}+(p')^{-1}=1$, and it is reflexive when $1<p<\infty $. The space $L^2(\Omega )$ has inner product $ (u,v)=\int _\Omega uv\, dx$.
